About Cvent:
www.cvent.com

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Role Overview

As a Product Manager II, you will be responsible for the development and execution of our product vision with the help of cross-functional teams through the entire product lifecycle. You will help with product research, roadmap prioritization, and work alongside engineers and designers to bring features to life. This is an ideal role for someone looking to grow in product management and gain hands-on experience with a dynamic team.

Responsibilities:

Develop an in-depth understanding of the business. products, including its goals and challenges, as well as a comprehensive knowledge of the customers and users of the platform. This involves analyzing their needs, behaviors, and pain points to ensure the product aligns with their expectations and delivers meaningful value.
Contribute in product discovery by identifying customer pain points and market opportunities by conducting user research, gathering feedback, and analyzing data to support product decisions.
Collaborate regularly with product managers on the future roadmap, brainstorm new ideas, and prioritize features, ensuring the backlog remains healthy, well-organized, and aligned with business goals.
Become a subject matter expert in your product domain, possessing in-depth knowledge and insights that make you the primary point of contact for internal teams seeking guidance and collaboration.
Develop detailed product specifications that begin by clearly articulating the “why” - the core purpose and value behind the product, feature, or enhancements. These specifications should be thorough in addressing all necessary aspects yet written in a clear and concise manner to ensure they are easily understood by all stakeholders.
Write comprehensive user stories with detailed acceptance criteria that address all functional and non-functional aspects of the product, including security, data compliance, and other essential requirements.
Work closely with engineering, design (UX/UI), and other stakeholders to ensure smooth product development and delivery. Also, ensure that all stakeholders are aligned with the product strategy and updates.
Lead end-to-end product development process, from concept and design to development, testing, launch and ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Lead PI (Program Increment) planning and actively participate in key SCRUM ceremonies, including daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and product demos.
Participate in go-to-market (GTM) strategies, product documentation, and feature releases to ensure successful product launches.
Participate in beta programs and user testing sessions to gather direct feedback on product features and help iterate on future improvements.
Should possess a solid grasp of technology platforms, integrations, and system design to collaborate effectively with engineering partners.
Leverage the power of analytics and data-driven intelligence to assess product performance, user behavior analysis, gather customer feedback, and insights from multiple channels, and make data-informed decisions which enables you to drive excellence through iteration, improvement, and refinement.
Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to gauge the effectiveness, adoption, and product outcome.
Share and present regular updates on the product roadmap and progress to leaders and stakeholders. Clearly highlight any potential risks and outline a plan to address them, ensuring everyone is informed and aligned on the path forward.
Contribute to a culture of creativity and innovation within the product management team, think outside the box, explore new ideas, and identify opportunities to make our products stand out in the market.
Proven ability to manage stakeholders effectively and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, fostering collaboration and driving alignment toward shared goals.

What we are looking for:

Minimum 9-11 years of career experience with at least 7 years of product management (PO/PM) experience in technology products.
Strong product sense with an ability to articulate problems and envision solutions.
Strong understanding of technology and software development processes, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams.
Inquisitive mindset with excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to manage competing and evolving priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to handle complex situations, conversations and navigate ambiguity.
Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, partner and build relationships across all levels of the organization.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to communicate directly and clearly.

Required Qualifications

Graduate degree or equivalent experience
8+ years in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Technology Delivery
Experience with AI based product is mandatory
Proven experience shipping AI-native or agentic products involving orchestration, tool use, retrieval, and autonomous decision-making
Experience with AI-native development practices and human-in-the-loop systems
Proven solid expertise in backlog management, user stories, Agile delivery, and tools such as Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or Aha!

Ideal Candidate

A technically strong product leader who can bridge business strategy and engineering execution, harness AI to solve healthcare challenges, and consistently deliver impactful business outcomes.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

About the Role
Anupam Finserv Ltd is building a full-stack digital lending platform spanning LOS, LMS, and collections.
We are looking for a Product Manager with 2–5 years of Product experience to own and build critical lending journeys for a listed NBFC.
Beyond building and scaling our lending application, the role will also involve developing lending programs across fintech products, including working with companies backed by some of India’s largest funds and founders like Deepinder Goyal. Key Responsibilities

Define and drive the roadmap across growth, risk, compliance, and operational efficiency

2–5 years of Product Management experience
Strong understanding of the fintech / lending / NBFC ecosystem
Hands-on experience with SQL and data analysis
Proven track record of improving product and business metrics
Strong written and verbal communication
Ability to work with ambiguity and in high-ownership environments
Why Join Us
Own mission-critical lending journeys end-to-end
Work directly with the founders of a listed NBFC
Build lending products and programs across the fintech ecosystem
Build products in a regulated, high-impact environment
Experience high ownership, fast execution, and real financial impact
Core employees get the perk of the larger upside
Location: Mumbai / India
Reporting To: CEO / CBO

Interested candidates kindly reach out to chanda@anupamfinserv.com

About The Role

In this role you'll help drive product strategy for Financial Edge NXT, our nonprofit fund accounting platform. Our customers depend on compliance, audit trails, and doing more with fewer people, which is exactly why AI matters here: every hour we save a nonprofit finance team on reconciliation is an hour back toward mission work. This isn't a "keep the backlog full" role. We're actively building anomaly detection assistants for AP fraud and restricted fund compliance, expanding AI-powered health scoring across the product, and shipping virtual agents to build a back-office team inside Financial Edge NXT. You'll be leading the conversation for how these are designed, prioritized, scoped, and sold.

What You'll Do

Own product requirements and roadmap decisions for Financial Edge NXT’s features across fund accounting workflows, from anomaly detection to reconciliation tools.
Translate deep nonprofit accounting domain knowledge into product decisions that hold up against how these organizations operate day to day
Partner with engineering, design, and go-to-market to move features from concept to general availability, and stay in the loop through adoption and iteration
Build the business case, requirements, and go-to-market strategies for new capabilities to sell internally and externally.
Collaborate with and represent the product in front of customers and prospects, including sales enablement and competitive positioning.
Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of product management experience shipping software from concept to launch, ideally in financial platforms or vertical SaaS
A default to AI-first development practices
Strong understanding of financial workflows and ability to have credible conversations with financial users and leaders
Experience scoping and shipping AI or agentic-powered features, including the tradeoffs around trust, accuracy, and explainability that matter especially in finance
Comfort owning both the strategic narrative (why this matters, where it's going) and the tactical (user stories, backlog, sprint reviews)
Strong written communication. You'll be writing docs that go to engineering, sales, and leadership, and they all need to land differently.

About Refold AI 

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

What you'll do:

Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

What we're looking for:

You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

Experience

5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

Responsibilities And Essential Functions

AI-First Product Strategy & Execution

Translate product vision into prioritized features (epics) and user stories that leverage AI capabilities such as workflow automation, predictive intelligence (e.g., sales/service optimization), and generative experiences (e.g., conversational interfaces, content generation).
Identify opportunities to create platform-level AI capabilities that scale across CDK products.

Business Case & Value Realization

Develop and contribute to business cases that quantify the value of AI-enabled features, including efficiency gains, revenue lift, and cost savings.
Align product investments with strategic goals and measurable dealership outcomes.

Backlog & Delivery Leadership

Own and prioritize product backlogs, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and AI/data readiness.
Partner with R&D, Data Science, and Scrum Masters to drive efficient execution across the full lifecycle (definition, development, testing, beta, release, retrospectives).

Cross-Product & Ecosystem Alignment

Identify and manage interdependencies across CDK product lines to ensure seamless, integrated dealer experiences.
Collaborate with other Product Managers to align on shared capabilities, data models, and AI strategies.

Customer & Market Insight

Act as the voice of the customer by synthesizing dealer feedback, behavioral data, and market trends.
Incorporate AI-driven insights and analytics into product decisions and prioritization.

Data-Driven Optimization & AI Performance

Define and monitor key success metrics, including traditional KPIs (adoption, revenue, NPS) and AI-specific metrics (model accuracy, precision/recall, utilization, automation rate).
Lead experimentation strategies (A/B testing, model evaluation) to continuously improve product performance.

Responsible AI & Governance

Ensure AI features adhere to principles of fairness, transparency, privacy, and accountability.
Mitigate risks related to bias, data quality, and model reliability.
Mentorship & Capability Building
Serve as a resource and mentor to junior product team members.
Promote AI-first product thinking and upskill the organization in data-driven and intelligent product development.
Follow all CDK Global policies and procedures
Complete all mandatory assigned compliance tasks and acknowledgements
Meet or exceed all performance expectations

Strategic thinking with strong execution focus

About Us
Pluang is Indonesia’s leading multi-asset investment platform, offering products such as US Stocks, Crypto, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure—so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $110M+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we’re one of Indonesia’s fastest-growing fintechs. Discover more about our vision here.

Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager based in Gurgaon to join our Global Products team. You will own and drive product outcomes across global investing products (e.g. US Stocks, ETFs, Options, Leverage, Commodities, Forex and adjacent platform capabilities), translating strategy into shipped products with high quality and operational excellence.
Given Pluang’s startup environment, scope can evolve over time. A meaningful part of this role will also involve helping build and launch Pluang Philippines (PH)—a highly exciting zero-to-one journey where you will launch the product by creating core platform flows (e.g., onboarding/KYC, wallet, top up/cash out, portfolio, and key trading/investing journeys) in a new market.

What You Will Do
1. Own delivery and outcomes across Global Products (US Stocks & Securities and beyond)
Drive execution of roadmap items across US Stocks, Options, ETFs, Leverage and other products- balancing customer value, risk, and operational constraints.
Translate strategy into crisp PRDs, user stories, and release plans; ensure high-quality delivery and clear success metrics.
Own post-launch iteration based on data, user feedback, and operational insights (not just shipping features).
2. Contribute to PH expansion (zero-to-one) through platform flows and market readiness
Support building PH-ready platform journeys including onboarding/KYC, wallet, top up/cash out, portfolio, and customer support readiness.
Work with Strategy/Compliance/Partnerships to translate market requirements into a phased roadmap (MVP → iteration → scale).
Ensure PH flows are measurable, reliable, and launch-ready with strong operational and compliance alignment.
3. Build and scale core investing journeys with a high bar for trust and usability
Improve key journeys such as discovery → onboarding → funding → trade execution → portfolio → reporting.
Drive UX improvements informed by funnel analytics, user feedback, and market benchmarks to increase conversion and repeat investing behaviors.
Ensure clarity and transparency in user-facing experiences (pricing/fees, leverage risks, order status, trade confirmations).
4. Drive data-informed optimization and experimentation
Own instrumentation and metrics for your domains; partner with Data to ensure dashboards are trusted and actionable.
Run structured experiments (A/B tests and iterative rollouts) to improve conversion funnels and product adoption.
Diagnose performance issues and drop-offs using cohort and funnel analysis; propose and execute solutions.
5. Lead cross-functional coordination and operational excellence
Partner with Engineering, Design, QA, Compliance, Operations, and Support to deliver end-to-end outcomes.
Proactively manage dependencies, execution risks, and stakeholder alignment—especially in regulated workflows.
Improve internal product operations: clearer processes, better launch checklists, stronger incident/learning loops.

Qualifications
4+ years of Product Management experience (or equivalent), ideally in fintech, brokerage, trading, payments, or other regulated consumer products.
Experience shipping complex product surfaces end-to-end with measurable impact.
Exposure to global investing products (US stocks/ETFs/leverage/derivatives) is a plus.

Skills & Competencies
Strong execution and product judgment: clear problem framing, crisp requirements, thoughtful prioritization.
Strong analytical ability: funnels, cohorts, experimentation rigor, and data-informed decision making.
Strong cross-functional leadership across Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, and Operations.
Ability to operate in ambiguity while maintaining a high quality bar and strong stakeholder alignment.

Mindset
Ownership-driven and outcome-oriented; comfortable being accountable for business and customer impact.
High bar for trust, compliance readiness, and operational excellence.
Curious and adaptable—able to flex scope as business priorities evolve.

Senior Product Manager, Loyalty

Team Description

The role sits within the Loyalty Product organization and is specifically focused on assurance products strategy for members across Hotels.com, Vrbo, and BEX. The broader loyalty team currently works across multiple areas including loyalty for other brands such as Expedia & Vrbo, 3P partnerships, AI/ML-driven personalization, promotions & incentives etc.

The team partners closely with brand GMs, marketing, engineering, design, finance, legal and other product stakeholders to improve the loyalty experience, drive clearer value for travelers, and increase outcomes such as active members, first transactions, repeat bookings, and direct return behavior for Expedia Group.

What You’ll Do

Define the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for loyalty assurance products across brands.
Set clear priorities across protection and flexibility offerings.
Partner with InsurTech, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Brand teams to drive discovery, delivery, and launch readiness.
Define the member value proposition and eligibility model for assurance benefits within One Key.
Use data, experimentation, and market insight to evaluate product fit and member impact.
Drive the in-product member experience for assurance products.
Align stakeholders around strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and investment decisions.
Manage ambiguity, unblock dependencies, and keep multiple workstreams moving in a highly matrixed environment.
Apply AI/ML and rule-based contextualization and personalization to improve member relevance and business outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

A clear cross-brand assurance strategy that connects loyalty benefits to repeat booking and member retention.
A prioritized roadmap that balances member value, commercial outcomes, and delivery feasibility.
Strong partnership with InsurTech that results in scalable, compliant, and brand-appropriate launches.
Measurable improvement in loyalty engagement, repeat purchase, and assurance adoption and usage.
Clear alignment across business and technical stakeholders throughout discovery and delivery.

Who You Are

An experienced product leader with a track record of owning complex, technical, cross-functional products.
Strong at product vision, roadmap definition, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
Comfortable operating across brands, geographies, and business models.
A clear communicator who can simplify sophisticated product and commercial concepts.
Data-driven, customer-focused, and comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
Skilled at leading through influence and collaborating across functions without direct authority.

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience leading complex product initiatives.
Experience leading highly technical consumer or platform products in a matrixed organization.
Proven track record of building and scaling products with multiple stakeholders and business constraints.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and business stakeholders.
Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with travel, fintech, insurance, loyalty, or marketplace products.
Experience working with partner-led product models and regulated or quasi-regulated offerings.
Experience with experimentation, personalization, segmentation, or behavioral analytics.
Ability to connect customer needs to measurable commercial and member outcomes.
Ability to lead through influence without direct authority.

Why this role matters

Assurance products are becoming an important part of the loyalty value proposition and a key lever for making One Key more relevant across brands and traveler segments. This role will help shape how Expedia Group turns that opportunity into a durable, differentiated member benefit.

About the Role

As a Product Manager, you will drive the success of tax and finance technology products throughout their lifecycle. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, and sales, to define and execute the product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plans. Your expertise in tax compliance, finance workflows, and emerging technologies will play a pivotal role in shaping innovative, customer-centric solutions.

Responsibilities

Define the product strategy and vision based on market research, customer insights, and business objectives.
Identify market opportunities, analyze competitive landscapes, and drive product innovation and differentiation.
Develop and maintain a clear product roadmap aligned with business goals.
Prioritize features and enhancements based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
Collaborate with stakeholders, including customers, sales, and engineering teams, to gather and document product requirements.
Define user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications with precision.
Work closely with engineering, design, and marketing teams to ensure seamless product development and delivery.

Overview

ABOUT JAGGAER

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.

Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com

JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education.

Job Title: Product Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

Reports To: Director of Product Management, JAI

Type: Full-Time

About The Role

This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.

The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.

You will work across the JAI portfolio, because the data and intelligence layer you own is what every agent and research capability in the product reasons over.

This is a strategy and delivery role in a single seat. You will set the direction, and you will be measured on what ships against it.

Principal Responsibilities

Product ownership: Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the data products built on them. 
AI-native insight capabilities: Define and deliver new AI capabilities in this space, including generated insight and anomaly detection across customer spend, taking them from concept through early access to general availability. 
Product direction: Define what analytics and data products become as AI absorbs them, including how customers consume data when their own systems and agents are the consumer rather than a person, and where the boundary sits between surfacing an insight and acting on it. Establish the product direction for agent-ready data delivery. 
Data trust and accuracy: Own the quality bar for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over: the definitions of core procurement measures, the evaluation approach that proves accuracy, and the standard a model must meet before it is used with a customer. 
Committed delivery: Meet the existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments already sold to customers, including those carried in active RFPs and renewals, and keep the install base on a clear roadmap. 
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with engineering, applied AI, UX, and the Experience, AgentOS and Deep Research product managers, so the data and intelligence layer serves the whole JAI portfolio rather than one surface. 
Market and customer insight: Validate problems and proposed capabilities directly with customers and prospects, and use that evidence to prioritise. Support analytics and data content in RFPs and executive briefings. 
Agile execution: Translate product requirements into clear, well-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery. 
Metrics and performance: Define and report the KPIs for this scope, including adoption of the AI insight surfaces, accuracy against the evaluation set, and delivery against customer commitments. 

Position Requirements

What You Will Bring

3+ years of product management experience in SaaS or enterprise software, including ownership of a product area end to end. 
Hands-on experience with AI products, including LLM-powered applications, prompt engineering, retrieval architectures, or applying AI to structured enterprise data. 
Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage. 
A rigorous approach to accuracy: comfort defining ground truth, designing evaluation sets, and holding a quality bar under delivery pressure. 
Experience working with enterprise customers to validate problems and quantify value, rather than gathering feature requests. 
Experience with procurement, source-to-pay, supply chain or finance data is an advantage. 
Proficiency in Agile methodologies and working closely with distributed engineering teams. 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. 

Success in This Position

An outcome focus, with customer value always in mind. 
Comfortable saying no to a capability that has not met the accuracy bar, and able to explain that decision commercially to sales and to customers. 
Able to hold both a multi-year product direction and a current-quarter delivery commitment without losing either. 
Strong written and verbal communication in English, and credible with both engineering and business leadership. 
Effective at influencing without authority across product, engineering and go-to-market teams. 
Accustomed to working in an international environment across multiple development sites and time zones. 

Goals for the First 12 Months

An agreed product direction for analytics and data products in an AI-first platform, signed off with Product and Engineering leadership and reflected in the roadmap. 
Generated insight and anomaly detection delivered to early access customers, with adoption and accuracy reported as the primary measures of success. 
A published quality and evaluation standard for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over, with accuracy tracked and reported. 
All existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments met, with a clear and communicated roadmap for the install base. 
Customer validation of the new AI capabilities in this space, with quantified outcomes suitable for use in renewals and new business. 

What We Offer

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. 

Our Values - T.E.A.M 

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies. 

Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Principal Product Manager, APAC Payments Scheme Integrations

Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. We need someone to help us move money seamlessly in APAC.

We process hundreds of millions of payments for our customers per year. When Wise started we used banks to power our payments. But as we’ve grown we’ve started connecting directly to national payment schemes such as Australia’s NPP, Singapore’s FAST, Philippines' InstaPay, and Japan’s Zengin.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead our efforts in integrating and optimising national payment scheme integrations across the APAC region. This role will focus on expanding Wise’s reach through new payment scheme integrations while continuously improving the performance of existing scheme integrations.

What You’ll Do

Understand customer needs: Build an understanding of how payment schemes impact our customers, and use this understanding to drive product decisions. 
Determine the strategy for Wise’s payment scheme integrations: Work with internal teams, regulators, and payment scheme operators in order to build a multi-year roadmap of which payment scheme functionality Wise should be connected to. Lobby for changes to payment schemes to make our customers' lives better.
Lead payment scheme integrations: Alongside engineering leads, you’ll be managing technical integrations with payment schemes. This will include working with multiple internal stakeholders, ensuring strong project management is in place, identifying risks and opportunities early and adapting to them.
Monitor and optimise: Use data to track the performance of integrations and drive continuous improvement.
Drive operational excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of the scheme integration.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring

Significant product management experience in payments, ideally in finance/fintech.
8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles. 
For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role
A knack for project management: This is not a project manager role, but payment scheme integrations have many moving parts and you will be accountable for the team’s success.
Analytical mindset: Ability to use data to make informed decisions and track performance metrics.
Customer focus: A passion for building products that solve real customer problems.
A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,
Nice to Have

Experience working with payment scheme integrations
Experience in fintech or a high-growth tech company.
The ability to write SQL
Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

SaaS applications and Enterprise SaaS ecosystems

About The Role

Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?

At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the Head of Product and Engineering, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.

In this dual-hatted role, you will:

Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms: Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.

Serve as the India Site Lead: Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.

This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.
India Site Leadership
Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture

We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:

Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)

Basic Qualifications:

Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications:

Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Why Join Citi?

Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

You start the day by reviewing portfolio-level progress across substation and grid monitoring products, gaining an overview of roadmap delivery, key risks, and interdependencies across regions and asset classes.

You meet with Product Managers to review product roadmaps, customer priorities, and execution status, ensuring alignment with the overall portfolio direction and business objectives. You work with R&D and engineering leaders to address major technical or capacity constraints and to ensure investments are focused on the most strategic initiatives.

In the afternoon, you focus on portfolio planning and steering: shaping the integrated portfolio roadmap, prioritizing initiatives across products, making investment trade-offs, and aligning with regional, commercial, and service organizations. You end the day advancing the long-term portfolio strategy for how Siemens Energy enables smarter, more resilient grid operations through monitoring, analytics, and digitalization.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Lead the Substation & Grid Monitoring portfolio, defining and owning the portfolio strategy and roadmap across asset classes, while driving prioritization and strategic trade offs to maximize customer value and business impact. 
Govern product strategy and roadmaps, providing oversight and challenge to ensure alignment with portfolio priorities, business objectives, and coherent execution across all products. 
Own the Health & Analytics Center (HAC) portfolio vision, setting strategic objectives, investment focus, and success criteria, while ensuring consistent translation into end to end product strategies and roadmaps. 
Shape the Digital Substation portfolio direction, defining priorities across monitoring, protection, control, and analytics, and ensuring cross product and cross unit alignment at portfolio level. 
Drive portfolio integration and cross functional alignment, resolving prioritization and dependency conflicts, setting portfolio guardrails, and ensuring clarity across regions, product lines, and adjacent portfolios. 
Hold portfolio level financial and organizational accountability, including R&D, CAPEX and OPEX planning, budget allocation, leadership and development of Product Management and Engineering functions, and external representation with customers, partners, and industry forums.


What You Bring

Completed university degree in electrical engineering or energy technology.
Strong product management and portfolio leadership experience in grid digitalization, substation automation with a proven ability to define product vision, portfolio strategy, and investment priorities across digital and physical grid domains.
Deep domain, technology, and digital understanding of grid digitalization concepts, protection & control systems, condition monitoring technologies, inspection data integration with strong software development foundations and machine learning analytics expertise as a distinct advantage, enabling informed portfolio-level strategic decisions grounded in technical and operational reality.
Demonstrated ability to lead and govern complex product portfolios, including responsibility for significant R&D budgets, CAPEX, and OPEX, and the capability to drive clear prioritization and investment trade-offs across grid digitalization initiatives and products.
Proven capability to translate customer needs, grid operational challenges, and market trends into differentiated product and portfolio strategies, working closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams to ensure effective translation into product strategies, roadmaps, and delivery outcomes.
Strong technical and business communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with customers, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders on grid digitalization strategy, product direction, and technology-enabled business value.
Collaborative yet decisive leadership style, suited to cross-functional, multi-disciplinary environments, with a demonstrated ability to align Product Management and Engineering teams around portfolio strategy, while maintaining clear ownership and accountability.


About The Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical


We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Description

Why We Need You – The Mission

Veryon is a global information services and software company that exists to make flying safer and more reliable. Our products help reduce operating costs, improve aircraft reliability, and support technical knowledge sharing and collaboration within the general, business, and commercial aviation, as well as military/defense and OEM industries.

At Veryon, we are an AI-forward company focused on driving innovation and efficiency through emerging technologies. We prioritize hiring individuals who embrace AI, think creatively about its application, and are excited to continuously evolve alongside it.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Senior Product Owner to partner closely with our Senior Product Manager and engineering team to drive delivery across a complex B2B SaaS platform.

This role blends strong execution of ownership (backlog, sprint support, detailed requirements) with strategic communication capability. The ideal candidate can both manage the details of feature delivery and confidently represent product initiatives in cross-functional and company-wide discussions.

This is a high-growth role with a clear path toward broader product ownership.

Mission of the Role

Ensure engineering teams have clear, structured, high-quality requirements.
Drive execution of roadmap initiatives from concept through release.
Represent product status and priorities clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
Act as a force multiplier for the Senior Product Manager.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Product Execution & Delivery Ownership
Own backlog grooming and sprint preparation.
Write clear user stories with structured acceptance criteria.
Identify edge cases, dependencies, and system impacts.
Partner with engineering to clarify requirements and reduce ambiguity.
Track delivery progress and proactively surface risks or blockers.
Cross-Functional Representation
Communicate roadmap progress and feature status clearly to Engineering, Support, Sales, and Leadership.
Summarize complex initiatives at both detailed and executive levels.
Translate business goals into actionable delivery priorities.
Systems & Workflow Thinking
Understand how changes in one area of the system impact others.
Evaluate downstream implications of product decisions.
Identify integration risks and cross-module dependencies.
Ask “what does this break?” before development begins.
Prioritization & Decision Support
Assist in prioritization based on business impact, customer value, and technical effort.
Provide structured recommendations when tradeoffs arise.
Operate effectively in ambiguity and incomplete information.
Continuous Improvement
Identify gaps in documentation or product clarity.
Improve internal product documentation and process structure.
Support post-release analysis and iteration.

What You’ll Accomplish – Your Performance Objectives

In Your First 6 Months

Engineering has significantly fewer clarification questions.
Sprint planning is structured and predictable.
Stakeholders receive consistent, clear status updates.
Risks are identified early rather than reactively.

In Your First 12 Months

Owns delivery of major initiatives independently.
Can confidently represent roadmap and status in company-wide meetings.
Begins taking ownership of specific product domains.

8+ years in Product, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
Experience in B2B SaaS environments.
Strong written requirements documentation skills.
Experience working with distributed teams (US/India time zones preferred).
Comfort working in complex, workflow-driven systems.
Strong structured thinking and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Experience with operational systems (ERP, logistics, maintenance, compliance, manufacturing, etc.).
Experience supporting complex multi-module platforms.
Experience presenting to leadership or senior stakeholders.
Exposure to US-based SaaS companies.

Who We’re Looking For – The Personal Competencies That Matter

Ownership mindset — takes responsibility for outcomes.
Executive-level communication — can summarize clearly and confidently.
Systems thinking — understands cross-functional impacts.
Proactive risk management — identifies issues early.
Structured documentation — clear, precise, organized writing.
Sound judgment — makes thoughtful decisions under uncertainty.

How We Work – The Core Values That We Live By

Fueled By Customers: We work hard so our customers can get more uptime. A customer-centered approach is on the forefront of our minds. We’re big on transparent communication with our customers, and we celebrate their wins internally because we love the positive impact we’re making on their lives. 
Win Together: We focus on the “we” and not the “me”. Collaboration is key, we value diverse backgrounds and skill sets. Our mission is to win as a team, we think everyone plays an integral part in our success. 
Make it Happen: When we make a commitment, we get it done. We take a proactive approach, we commit, we adapt to evolving landscapes and problems, we tackle problems at every difficulty level. 
Innovate to Elevate: We set the standard in aviation by embracing and advancing cutting edge technology. We take a fail-forward approach using everything as a learning experience. We encourage creativity and experimentation within our teams. This helps us set the bar high and provide world class expertise in aviation. 

Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. Company Description
ERP Logic is a globally recognized SAP Cloud Solutions company, specializing in SAP implementation and application services. Since its inception in 2009, the company has grown significantly to over 1,000 employees and expanded its presence across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, India, and Israel. As one of the top three SAP reseller partners globally for SAP S/4HANA Grow and SAP S/4HANA Rise, ERP Logic serves over 500 customers, including both large enterprises and mid-sized companies. With deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC, ERP Logic supports businesses in transitioning to advanced ERP systems with a customer-centric approach and sustainable solutions.

Role Description
The DADAI (Data, Analytics, Digital & AI Delivery) Domain Product Owner is accountable for translating approved product priorities into delivery-ready scope and for maximizing execution quality across products. The Product Owner owns the product backlog, clarifies requirements, defines acceptance criteria, and ensures delivery teams can execute with clear priorities, technical alignment, and quality standards.
The Product Owner acts as the primary delivery-facing interface between the domain Business Unit priorities (via the IT SHM / Product Manager) and the DADAI delivery factory / CoEs at the product level, ensuring continuous alignment between business intent, delivery execution, and backlog refinement.

Key Responsibilities
The Product Owner contributes execution input required for delivery planning, including:
· Translating approved business priorities into clear product scope, epics, features, and user stories.
· Identifying execution implications and collaborating with CoEs, Architecture, Data, and delivery teams to refine delivery-ready scope
· Assessing execution dependencies, technical constraints, regulatory considerations, and data readiness implications at product level
· Defining clear feature scope, acceptance criteria, assumptions, and delivery readiness inputs for planning
· Ensuring backlog items are complete, clear, and meet DADAI quality standards prior to PI / sprint planning and delivery execution
· Acting as the primary delivery-facing product authority for feature scope, backlog priorities, and acceptance decisions for ARTs, PODs, and vendor teams
· Supporting operational feedback loops by translating production learnings, defects, and enhancement requests into backlog refinement and prioritized delivery actions

Success Measures:
Delivery Readiness & Planning Quality
· Percentage of features entering PI / sprint planning with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and required architectural or data inputs identified.
· Minimizing late discovery of dependencies, data readiness gaps, or scope ambiguity during planning and execution.
Execution Quality
· Plan adherence of sprint / PI predictability for committed feature delivery.
· Percentage of accepted stories / features meeting definition of done without major rework.

Education and Skill-set Required
Data, Analytics, Digital, Automation or AI Products (5+ years)
· Proven ability to understand existing systems and data landscapes, business processes, integrations, and translate business needs into scalable digital, data, and AI solutions.
· Proven experience in business analysis and delivery for enterprise digital, data, analytics and AI solutions within complex, global organizations.
· Strong understanding of end‑to‑end data and analytics lifecycles, including data ingestion, modeling, transformation, analytics consumption, and operationalization of insights.
· Hands-on experience supporting the design, implementation, and adoption of business applications, and workflow‑based digital solutions across multiple business units.
· Experience working with analytics, AI, and ML-enabled solutions, including requirements definition, use‑case shaping, model integration into business processes, and alignment with platform and data governance standards.
· Solid knowledge of data concepts such as data modeling, data integration, data quality, and working with structured datasets to support reporting, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
· Strong understanding of relational databases and querying concepts (e.g., SQL or similar technologies), with the ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers and analytics teams. 
· Broad understanding of enterprise cloud ecosystems, including productivity platforms, data platforms, and cloud services supporting analytics and AI workloads.
Product Ownership in Enterprise IT (5+ years)
· Enterprise IT roles combining business‑facing product ownership with delivery execution
· Proven ability to operate within domain priorities while managing product‑level tradeoffs and dependencies
Backlog Refinement & Delivery Readiness (5+ years)
· Proven experience translating approved business priorities into epics, features, and user stories that are ready for delivery planning, including:
o Feature decomposition and backlog structuring
o Acceptance criteria definition and readiness for planning
o Dependency, technical constraint, and data readiness identification
o Preparation of delivery-ready inputs for PI / sprint planning
o Demonstrated ability to work in close partnership with a business‑facing leader (IT SHM / Product Manager) while owning backlog clarity, delivery readiness, and execution quality.
Technical Assessment & Data Quality (5+ years)
· Capability to perform high‑level technical assessment of data, digital and AI solutions, including dependencies, constraints, and implementation implications. 
· Strong focus on data quality assurance, including alignment on data definitions, quality checks, and acceptance metrics across the data pipeline and analytical outputs.
· Hands‑on experience driving product alignment with: 
o Enterprise Architecture
o Security and privacy
o Data governance 
Advantage - Domain Business Understanding (3+ years) 
· Hands‑on experience delivering, or product‑owning solutions in the pharma R&D business area.
· Strong ability to translate business processes and pain points into epics, features, and measurable product outcomes.

Preferred
Regulated or High‑Compliance Environment (2+ years)
· Experience delivering solutions in environments with: 
o Validation requirements
o Audit readiness
o Controlled release and change management practices (e.g., GxP)
Formal Certifications
· SAFe POPM, SAFe Practitioner, or equivalent agile/product certification.
· ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management exposure.

Key Capabilities and Skills
· Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
· Ability to translate business problems into clear, delivery-ready requirements
· Value-focused prioritization and decision-making
· Structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with ambiguity
· Collaborative mindset with delivery teams and business partners
· Demonstrated proficiency in data analysis, digital technologies, and AI literacy
· Understands enterprise platforms and constraints 
· Can assess technical impact of scope & priority decisions 
· Ensures quality and operability are built into the product
· Effective collaboration with engineers, architects, and Scrum / ART roles to remove ambiguity and enable predictable delivery

The Company

CommerceIQ is building the AI platform that runs commerce for the world's largest brands. We are not selling AI demos. We are shipping AI agents for content, media, and sales into the workflows of the Fortune 100 every week.

2,200+

Customers

10 of Top 12

CPG Companies

900+

Retailers Connected

$200M+

Raised

Customers include Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Mondelez, Samsung, and Kellogg's. Backed by SoftBank, Insight Partners, and Madrona. Headquartered in Mountain View with teams across the US, India, Canada, and the UK. Pre-IPO.

Director of Product, Retail Media

The Opportunity

Retail media is CommerceIQ's biggest and fastest-growing product line, and it sits inside one of the fastest-growing categories in all of advertising. US retail media ad spend is growing roughly 18% year over year in 2026, nearly double the growth rate of digital advertising overall, and it's on track to keep outpacing search and social for years to come.

We have a real chance to be the world's best at this. Not the best software vendor, the best at actually delivering the outcome: incremental sales lift from media investment. We already have a significant lead here through our work on incrementality measurement, we can prove the sales lift our customers get from their media spend in a way most of the market can't. What we need now is someone who can take that lead and turn it into a category-defining, agentic product.

How We Go to Market

Our model is services as software: an agent plus a managed services team working together, owning the outcome for the customer rather than just handing them a dashboard. This role is about taking that model and re-architecting it, from a SaaS + services model to an agent-native services product line, one that can scale 10x over the next one to two years without scaling headcount at the same rate.

What You'll Own

Own delivery and execution for the entire retail media product line, and build and lead the team that drives it.
Partner closely with the VP, Retail Media to shape strategy and roadmap, then run the execution end to end.
Lead the transition from a SaaS + services model to an agent-native services product line, working closely with engineering.
Build a stronghold with our customers, working backwards from their real workflows and needs rather than assumptions.
Partner with sales on GTM: deal support, positioning, and translating the incrementality and agent story into pipeline and renewals.
Build and prioritize features that directly drive ARR growth in retail media.
Drive rapid prototyping of new agent capabilities and build the playbooks that let the team repeat what works across customers.

What You'll Bring

5-10+ years of experience in product management or equivalent roles, with a track record owning delivery and execution for a meaningful, revenue-generating product line, ideally one you scaled significantly.
Genuinely AI-forward: you've built or shipped with LLMs, agents, and modern AI tooling, not just read about them.
Experience running a team while partnering closely with a peer or senior leader on strategy.
Strong instincts for customer-facing work: you can sit with a customer, understand their workflow, and translate it into product.
Experience partnering closely with engineering and with sales/GTM teams.
High ownership and comfort operating as the de facto GM of this product line's delivery.
Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

Nice to Have

Retail media or ad tech experience.
Background in incrementality measurement, marketing mix modeling, or media attribution.
Prior experience taking a SaaS product agentic.

HighLevel’s Commerce platform is the system of record for how our customers sell — what they offer and how it is priced, how orders get fulfilled, and how money moves: payments in, invoices out, and books that balance . It spans product information, pricing, taxes, and channels; fulfillment and inventory; and the full finance stack of payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger — together powering commerce for a global base of agencies and businesses operating at scale.

We are seeking a Group Product Manager, Commerce , to lead product across three connected verticals — Business Operations, Fulfillment Operations, and Finance — and the team of Product Managers who own them. You will set the strategy for the end-to-end commerce lifecycle, from catalog to cash , and be accountable for the coherence, reliability, and growth of the platform as a whole.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who has managed and grown other Product Managers , and who can zoom from platform strategy down to the details of a pricing engine, a fulfillment flow, or a ledger entry. Deliver Fulfillment Operations – Steer fulfillment, inventory, and the upcoming warehousing, time-clocking, and metering charters so what was sold reliably reaches the buyer.

Deliver Finance – Own the payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger/accounting roadmap, ensuring money moves securely and the books balance across providers and external systems like QuickBooks and Xero.

Own Outcomes & Metrics – Drive measurable growth in GMV, transaction success, merchant adoption, and reliability , using data to prioritize across a large and competing set of bets.

Partner with Senior Stakeholders – Work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and leadership to align on strategy, resourcing, and trade-offs, and represent Commerce in company-level planning.

Balance Delivery & Long-Term Bets – Keep near-term charters shipping on time while investing in the platform foundations that compound over the next several years .

Raise the Operating Bar – Establish the rituals, specs, and quality standards — discovery, prioritization, launch, and review — that make the team predictable, fast, and outcome-driven .

Experienced People Leader – You have managed and grown Product Managers, and you get energy from multiplying your impact through a strong, well-run team .

Platform & Commerce Depth – You have led product across commerce, payments, fintech, or a comparable transaction-heavy platform , and understand how catalog, fulfillment, and finance fit together.

Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can define a multi-vertical strategy and still hold your teams to crisp execution , ensuring ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.

Systems Thinker – You see the interdependencies across modules and design for coherence, reuse, and shared contracts rather than one-off solutions.

Outcome- & Customer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the merchants who run their business on the platform at the center of every decision.

Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable prioritizing across a broad, messy portfolio, using data to make sharp trade-offs without waiting for perfect information.

Strong platform and systems judgment , with the ability to reason about how pricing, fulfillment, payments, invoicing, and ledger interconnect . 
Experience partnering with senior engineering, design, and business stakeholders to set strategy, secure resourcing, and drive company-level outcomes.

ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
  • Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
  • Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
  • Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
  • Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
  • Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
  • Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
  • Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
  • Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
  • Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.
  • AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
  • Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
  • Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
  • First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
  • High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
  • Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.
