Job Summary

At Arctic Wolf, you won t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - youll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We re looking for a Product Manager-Platform to be part of making this/that happen.

Position Overview and Objective

This Technical Product Manager role drives requirements, execution, and delivery for reliable, scalable data lake infrastructure and intelligent AI/ML capabilities that power Arctic Wolf s security products and platform operations. The TPM translates complex business, security, and operational needs into clear product requirements and technical specifications-initially supporting 1-2 engineering squads (scaling to 2+) across sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and milestone tracking. The role collaborates closely with Data Engineers, Data Science Engineers, Platform Architects and cross-functional stakeholders to support use cases such as log availability, telemetry analysis, threat detection, and intelligent alerting while ensuring solutions adhere to robust data security, privacy, and governance standards. The role requires foundational technical fluency in distributed data systems and AI/ML lifecycles, Agile execution, and the ability to represent data platform capabilities authoritatively to integrating teams.

Responsibilities

  • Works with senior PMs to understand how data platform infrastructure and AI-enabled capabilities align with the broader platform vision and roadmap.
  • Gathers and authors requirements, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data pipelines, query services, data lake access layers, and AI/ML model integration workflows. Defines project-level success criteria.
  • Owns the product backlog and delivery execution for 1-2 engineering squads (growing to 2+), managing prioritization, dependencies, risk mitigation, and on-time release milestones.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders (Platform Engineering, Data Science teams, Security Operations, and Architecture) to assess system capabilities, onstraints, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Validates, where possible, that High-Level Designs (HLDs) cover all validated use cases, data processing workflows, and performance requirements for platform features.
  • Presents direction, roadmaps, and delivery status for data platform and intelligent capabilities to development teams and consuming product stakeholders.
  • Answers authoritatively questions from teams integrating against data platform APIs, pipelines, and data access layers: what is supported today, what needs to be specified, and what is out of scope.
  • Identifies high-demand, heavy-lift platform requests, cost-optimization opportunities, and emerging AI use cases for consideration in future strategy and planning sessions.

Knowledge & Experience

  • Knowledge of Product Management discipline, requirements definition, and Agile/Scrum ceremonies and practices.
  • Educational background in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or 2-5 years of equivalent technical/product experience.
  • Foundational understanding of distributed data systems, data pipelines, relational/non-relational data modeling, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure components (e.g., AWS, GCP).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and lifecycle concepts (e.g., training datasets, model evaluation metrics, inference pipelines, anomaly detection, or NLP).
  • Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Begins to develop a system-level approach, understanding how data platform architecture, query performance, and indexing decisions ripple across consuming security products and operational costs.
  • Exposure to security concepts such as logging pipelines, telemetry analysis, monitoring, or threat detection systems a plus.

Complexity and Problem Solving

  • Collaborates with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Data Science Engineers, and internal stakeholders to maintain backlog priority, sizing, and acceptance criteria for data platform and AI enablement work.
  • Communicates and escalates unexpected delays, cross-team blockers, data quality issues, or non-prioritized asks from integrating teams.
  • Analyzes platform telemetry, query latency/throughput, data reliability metrics, and performance signals to determine the highest-value backlog items and platform optimizations.

Collaboration & Interaction

  • Partners with Engineering to define technical acceptance criteria and ensure tickets/epics are properly documented before scheduling into sprints.
  • Collaborates with consuming product teams and operational stakeholders to define success criteria and validate that data platform and AI features resolve the intended operational challenges.
  • Engages Engineering to monitor telemetry related to platform usage, storage/compute efficiency, and AI effectiveness, reporting regularly on key operational metrics.
  • Develops strong working relationships with Engineering and Data Science teams as a trusted technical subject-matter partner, and proactively collaborates with peer Product Managers as well as cross functional teams.

Why This Role

This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. Youll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. Youll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart.

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Introduction

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Product Manager to own product strategy and measurable outcomes for the tools and workflows that power Customer Support (CS) and Trust & Safety (TnS) for Mercari.

You will identify high-impact problems, create the roadmap, write clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure results. This role requires strong product judgment, practical use of data and AI, and the ability to bridge Japan-based stakeholders and the India engineering team in Japanese and English.

About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercaris applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about Four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect Indias cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

  • Go Bold
  • All for One
  • Be a Pro
  • Move Fast

Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations:

  • Sustainability
  • Diversity & Inclusion
  • Trust & Openness
  • Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari s culture.

Work Responsibilities

Own Product Strategy and Outcomes
  • Define the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes for CS and TnS
  • Identify opportunities using customer feedback, operational insights, and data
  • Define success metrics, baselines, guardrails, and post-launch measurement plans
  • Balance customer experience, operational efficiency, risk, and business priorities
Lead Discovery and Delivery
  • Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch plans
  • Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear priorities for engineering
  • Manage projects from discovery through development, rollout, adoption, and iteration
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions across teams
Improve CS and TnS Products
  • Build tools and workflows that improve support quality, resolution speed, and operational productivity
  • Improve user reports, escalations, moderation, case management, and enforcement experiences
  • Identify opportunities for workflow simplification and automation while preserving appropriate human judgment
  • Partner with CS, TnS, engineering, data, ML, policy, and business teams to deliver measurable impact
Use AI and Connect Japan and India
  • Use AI to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, prototyping, and product workflows
  • Lead discussions and create clear product documentation in Japanese and English
  • Build shared context and align Japan-based stakeholders with the India engineering team

Bold Challenges

The role balances customer experience, operational efficiency, marketplace risk, and business priorities while improving the tools and workflows used by CS and TnS teams. Success requires identifying high-impact problems, aligning Japan-based stakeholders and the India engineering team, and turning ambiguous operational needs into measurable product outcomes.

Minimum Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in product management or a related field, with hands-on experience delivering digital products
  • Japanese proficiency equivalent to JLPT N3 or above, with strong conversational ability to lead discussions with Japan-based stakeholders. Practical communication skills are more important than certification alone.
  • Experience owning product work from discovery and roadmap creation through launch and measurement
  • Ability to define measurable outcomes and make decisions using qualitative and quantitative data

  • Familiarity with experimentation, workflow automation, or AI-enabled products
  • Experience working in distributed or multicultural teams

PURPOSE


The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, commercial performance, and success of Evenica's eCommerce platform.

This role focuses on understanding customer and market needs, defining what the platform should do and why, and prioritizing work that delivers the greatest customer and business value.


The Senior Product Manager will take ownership of an established product and platform, understand its existing capabilities, customers, roadmap, and processes, and help define its next stage of growth. The expectation is not simply to continue with what is already established, but to evaluate existing approaches, strengthen product practices where required, and establish a clear product direction based on customer, market, commercial, and business needs.


The Senior Product Manager partners closely with Engineering leadership, who own how the platform is built, and with Project Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and leadership to ensure the platform's direction supports Evenica's growth objectives.

Own the Product Strategy and Roadmap

Manage Stakeholders and Product Priorities

• Own one AI, ML, or computer-vision product end to end: problem, users, roadmap, release.
  • Set the KPI a release has to move, and hold the gate when it does not clear it.
  • Decide what ships, what waits, and what dies.


Working with engineering
  • Write specs that survive the codebase, the kind engineers trust.
  • Reason about architecture, cost, and latency well enough that no one can bluff you.
  • Prototype your own ideas with AI tools instead of delegating every question.


The hard part, the part most product managers dodge
  • Design for the failure mode, not just the demo: the edge cases, the false positives, the long tail, the last twenty percent.
  • Ship against evals and real numbers, not a spec that is either met or not.
  • Build the guardrails and the fallback that turn a demo into something an enterprise will actually run.


Outcomes, not output
  • Tie the work to a number the business actually feels.
  • Turn what works once into something repeatable.
  • Say plainly what is on track and what is slipping, every week.


This role is not for you if
  • You need the product handed to you before you can care about it.
  • You think generative AI is the whole of AI.
  • You count features shipped instead of the number you moved.
  • You go quiet at eighty percent instead of owning the last twenty.
  • You need a title to feel credible, or you think a title is enough.
  • You want predictable, low-stakes, roadmap-and-standups work.


How to apply
  • Apply through the steps that follow. The questions are built to surface how you think and what you have built, not how well you polish a resume. AI-written answers are obvious, and they are rejected.
  • Everything you write, we will dig into if we talk.

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

We are looking for an Aerospace Development Manager to lead and grow our Aerospace portfolio, with a strong focus on customer acquisition, retention and business growth.

How you create impact

• Lead and grow the Aerospace portfolio, driving customer acquisition, retention and long-term relationships.
• Own and manage the P&L, ensuring sustainable revenue and profitability growth.
• Lead the implementation and onboarding of new business awards, ensuring operational readiness and service delivery.
• Partner closely with Sales and Pricing teams to identify and convert new business opportunities.

• 4–5 years of Product Management experience, specifically within the Aerospace division.
• Strong and direct Aerospace industry exposure, with a solid understanding of Aerospace logistics products and operations.

• Demonstrated people management and leadership experience.
• Strong understanding of Aerospace operations, customer requirements and service delivery.
• Ability to work effectively with Sales, Pricing, Operations, Customers and external partners.

• Commercially driven with the ability to identify opportunities and translate them into sustainable business growth.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Interacts frequently with customers, and generates customer requirements.

Anticipates customer needs and prioritizes those for the organization.

Understands how his/her role impacts customer satisfaction.

Continuously aims to meet customer expectations without compromising commercial viability and quality of the product.

Evaluates product hypotheses in a quantitative manner, including AB testing for interactive products.

Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

Generates new ideas by analyzing product data for insights.

Answers sales and customer questions regarding feature function, pricing, packaging, value proposition and competition.

Offers enablement sessions and provide materials in support of operations for market rollout, for Sales and customer facing teams

Solves customer issues with product and content aligned with business goals

Creates product development plans including opportunity assessment and business case.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

Job Overview:

LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.

This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.

The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

Responsibilities:

Product Discovery & Capability Support

Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.

Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.

Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving

Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.

Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.

Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.

Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)

Support Data Product Owners by helping define:

Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions

Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls

Usage expectations and downstream dependencies

Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.

Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.

Agile Execution & Delivery

About HighLevel

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team

The Marketing OS – LeadGen Team owns the products and platform capabilities that help agencies attract, engage, capture, qualify, and understand leads across digital and offline customer journeys.

The team is responsible for:

Forms and form-building experiences

Surveys and customer data-collection workflows

Quizzes, assessments, and interactive lead-generation experiences

QR Codes and offline-to-online lead acquisition

Chat Widget and conversational lead capture

External Tracking across third-party websites and digital properties

Lead capture, submission, attribution, and behavioral analytics

Templates, integrations, embeddable experiences, and extensibility

These products are critical entry points into the HighLevel Marketing OS. They connect customer interactions across websites, landing pages, physical locations, campaigns, and external properties with HighLevel's CRM, automation, analytics, and communication capabilities.

Why Join HighLevel?

Ownership: It is never somebody else's job.

Customer focus: We are passionately focused on adding value for our users.

Speed: We use lean principles and go to market in weeks rather than quarters.

Experimentation: Good ideas are tested quickly, measured, and improved iteratively.

Growth: You will help scale a global B2B SaaS platform and build products used by millions of businesses.

People: We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users.

Role Overview

As Senior Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen, you will help shape the future of lead generation at HighLevel.

You will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across a portfolio that includes Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, External Tracking, and adjacent lead capture and attribution capabilities.

Your mandate will be to evolve these products into a cohesive LeadGen experience that enables agencies and SMBs to create high-converting acquisition journeys, collect better-quality data, understand visitor behavior, and activate every lead through HighLevel's CRM and automation ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data on your portfolio, partner with adjacent product teams on shared foundations, and help shape how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.

Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.

Your Responsibilities

Own the LeadGen roadmap: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap across Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, and External Tracking.

Build cohesive experiences: Drive consistency across builders, templates, publishing, data models, integrations, analytics, and reporting.

Improve lead capture: Ship capabilities that increase visitor engagement, completion rates, lead quality, qualification, routing, and follow-up.

Connect the customer journey: Partner with CRM, Workflows, Conversations, Analytics, and Payments teams to connect interactions with downstream business outcomes.

Drive External Tracking: Define how HighLevel captures visitor behavior, conversions, identity, attribution, and campaign activity across third-party websites.

Strengthen analytics foundations: Contribute to consistent event taxonomies, instrumentation standards, and reporting across the LeadGen portfolio.

Drive AI-assisted creation: Deliver AI-powered creation, copy generation, logic recommendations, qualification, insights, and conversion optimization.

Improve cross-device experiences: Ensure creation and consumption experiences are intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant across desktop, mobile, and tablet.

Partner on technical decisions: Work with Engineering on builders, embeddable widgets, APIs, submission pipelines, tracking scripts, identity resolution, and event infrastructure.

Drive cross-functional execution: Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, Security, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships around shared outcomes.

Support go-to-market: Contribute to product positioning, pricing, packaging, messaging, launches, enablement, onboarding, and customer education.

Operate hands-on: Write PRDs and strategy documents, conduct discovery, analyze data, validate concepts, prioritize initiatives, and resolve ambiguity.

Own measurable outcomes: Drive improvements in adoption, activation, publishing, engagement, completion, conversion, attribution coverage, and retention.

Experience

7+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, analytics, growth, or customer-engagement platforms.

Experience owning a customer-facing product or product area end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration.

Experience defining and executing a roadmap across multiple related product areas.

Strong understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, qualification, and growth loops.

Experience with products such as forms, surveys, quizzes, chat widgets, analytics, attribution, tracking, or interactive content.

Familiarity with behavioral tracking, including page views, clicks, scrolls, field interactions, submissions, abandonment, and conversion events.

Understanding of event taxonomies, analytics instrumentation, data pipelines, experimentation, and marketing attribution.

Exposure to embeddable products such as widgets, scripts, SDKs, forms, or externally hosted experiences.

Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, CRM integrations, field mapping, workflow automation, and identity resolution.

Experience partnering with Engineering on frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure systems.

Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and UI/UX sensibility.

Ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive alignment without direct authority.

Excellent written and verbal communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

About HighLevel

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

HighLevel processes payments at significant scale for the businesses that run on our platform and yet only a fraction of the businesses we serve have adopted payments at all. The constraint is structural rather than one of awareness: adoption is decided by the agencies who serve these businesses, and they have never had a commercial reason to act. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager - Commerce Growth to close that gap and make payments adoption the fastest-compounding line in our Commerce business.

This role owns the adoption and monetisation charter for Commerce end to end. It spans partner incentive design, the growth mechanics that move a business from signing up to transacting consistently, the partner-facing surfaces those programmes live in, and the commercial model underneath them. It is a general-management role as much as a product one, you will own the unit economics, the programme budget, and the evidence that the investment is working.

This role is ideal for product managers who have built growth or partner programmes at scale, who are comfortable being measured on a commercial outcome rather than a feature list, and who bring the analytical rigour to distinguish growth that was genuinely caused from growth that would have happened anyway.

What You'll Do

Own the payments adoption charter end to end - the strategy, roadmap and operating plan that take adoption and transacting volume to a multiple of today's levels, and the commercial targets attached to them.

Design, launch and iterate partner incentive programmes that make adoption commercially compelling for the agencies who drive it including eligibility models, qualification logic, payout mechanics and the controls that keep the programmes durable and abuse-resistant.

Own the partner-facing product surfaces where these programmes are discovered, understood and acted on progress, earnings and next-best-action, designed to scale to tens of thousands of partners without manual support.

Own the unit economics: customer acquisition cost, payback period, contribution margin and programme budget - modelled, forecast, and defensible to Finance and leadership.

Build a disciplined experimentation practice - randomised tests, holdout groups and incrementality measurement so that pricing and programme decisions are evidence-led rather than intuition-led.

Apply growth-hacking rigour across the adoption funnel: segmentation, lifecycle triggers, in-product prompts and targeted campaigns, in partnership with Lifecycle Marketing, Community and Support.

Lead commercial conversations with our largest agency partners, where bespoke arrangements rather than self-serve programmes are what move the number.

Own the monthly performance narrative - adoption, retention, cost efficiency and programme health and the decision to scale, hold or retire each initiative.

Partner with Analytics, Finance, Risk and Commerce platform engineering on the measurement, controls and infrastructure the charter depends on.

What Success Looks Like

Payments adoption grows at a multiple of its current rate, with the uplift demonstrably attributable to the work rather than to underlying trend

Incentive investment pays back inside its target window, measured on contribution rather than headline revenue

Partners understand what they have earned and why, without needing to contact support

Programme abuse remains negligible and is contained by automated controls rather than manual review

Programme spend tracks forecast, with variance understood and explained

Minimum Qualifications

8–10 years of product management experience

Experience owning a growth, partner, referral or incentive programme where the commercial mechanic itself was the product

Comfort owning a commercial outcome end to end acquisition cost, payback, contribution margin and defending it to a finance audience

A track record of running controlled experiments and drawing the right conclusion from them, including the unwelcome one

Experience with payments, fintech, marketplaces or another business where unit economics are the product strategy

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in partner, reseller or franchise ecosystems where a third party not the end user makes the adoption decision

Familiarity with payment economics: processing rates, take rate, volume tiers, and how payment method mix affects platform monetisation

Experience designing abuse and fraud controls for a rewards, referral or affiliate programme

Background in vertical SaaS or platform businesses that monetise payments alongside subscriptions

Who This Role Is For

Product managers who think in unit economics, and who will hold the line when an initiative is popular but does not pay for itself.

PMs who treat commercial programmes as product surfaces with an interface, a rulebook and a feedback loop rather than a spreadsheet handed to marketing.

People energised by a very specific problem: getting tens of thousands of independent businesses to act on your behalf, repeatedly, at a price that makes sense.

Why Should You Join Us?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.
